title: Strict enlargement of a finite etale extension open
statement: Let S be an integral normal Noetherian quasi-separated scheme (normality means its local rings are integrally closed), c:C → S a qcqs smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres, σ:S → C a section, K the function field, and q:Cη → Spec K, j:Cη → C the cartesian generic fibre [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-pc-fibre-product]. Let sη:Spec K → Cη be the induced section, G a finite group with invertible order on S, and Z a finite étale G-torsor over Cη with a K-rational point over sη. Let U ⊊ S be an open containing the generic point. Suppose jU:Cη → c⁻¹(U) factors j and π:P → c⁻¹(U) is finite étale with ψ:Z.P → P giving its cartesian generic restriction. Then there is a strictly larger open V with U ⊊ V, containing the generic point, a factorization jV of j through c⁻¹(V), and a finite étale morphism π':P' → c⁻¹(V) with ψ':Z.P → P' giving its cartesian generic restriction. No compatibility map P → P' is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the local overlap extension to PA obtained by bundling the given finite etale morphism pi. Obtain W, s outside U in W, Q, and an overlap isomorphism.

Set V=U union W. Then U is contained in V and the witness s shows the reverse inclusion fails, so U<V. The generic point stays in V. The canonical inclusions of c inverse U and c inverse W into c inverse V cover that scheme. Their intersection square is cartesian by Mathlib isPullback_opens_inf_le. Apply finite etale two-open gluing with the supplied overlap isomorphism to obtain PV and an isomorphism of its restriction to c inverse U with PA.

The underlying inverse of the restriction isomorphism, followed by the pullback first projection, gives f:P -> PV whose square over the open inclusion is cartesian. Define jV as jU followed by that inclusion, and psiV as psi followed by f. Canonical inclusion composition proves jV factors j. Paste the given generic restriction square with the square for f to prove that psiV gives the required generic restriction. Finiteness and etaleness are the bundled properties of PV.

theorem GaloisCover.exists_larger_open_finiteEtale_model {S C : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    (σ : S ⟶ C) (hσ : σ ≫ c = 𝟙 S)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (sη : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Cη) (hsq : sη ≫ q = 𝟙 _)
    (hsj : sη ≫ j = S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S) ≫ σ)
    (Z : GaloisCover G Cη) (hZ : ∃ z : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Z.P, z ≫ Z.π = sη)
    (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U) (hU : U ≠ ⊤)
    (jU : Cη ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (P : Scheme.{u})
    (π : P ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (ψ : Z.P ⟶ P)
    (hjU : jU ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = j) (hπ : IsFinite π) (hEt : Etale π)
    (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π π jU) :
    ∃ V : S.Opens, U < V ∧ genericPoint S ∈ V ∧
      ∃ (jV : Cη ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) (P' : Scheme.{u})
        (π' : P' ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme) (ψ' : Z.P ⟶ P'),
        jV ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι = j ∧ IsFinite π' ∧ Etale π' ∧
          IsPullback ψ' Z.π π' jV
